premises.text: Women can choose the price they want to pay for coveted handbags and accessories that rarely go on sale
premises.evidence_span: we allow women to choose the price they want to pay for the most coveted handbags and accessories that either never or rarely go on sale

premises.text: The platform uses a game-like element to build buzz and create demand
premises.evidence_span: using a game-like element to build buzz and create new demands

premises.text: Members can purchase credits to participate in sales
premises.evidence_span: she must first purchase to buy for credit. A single credit costs 99 cents

premises.text: The price of items drops as more members join the sale
premises.evidence_span: the price will drop by $100 in 10 minutes. However, if 500 members are participating in the sale, the price will drop by $250 in that same 10-minute span

premises.text: Brands benefit from cost-effective marketing techniques through the platform
premises.evidence_span: brands get one of those cost-effective marketing techniques in years

premises.text: The business model includes collecting markups and entrance fees
premises.evidence_span: we collect the markup between the wholesale cost of an item and its final sale price on the site. Second, we collect entrance fees from each player

premises.text: The platform can achieve higher gross margins than traditional retailers
premises.evidence_span: this results in a gross margin of about 60%, significantly higher than the 35% to 40% average gross margin at traditional retailers

premises.text: The platform can attract users through targeted advertising and viral marketing
premises.evidence_span: we actually end up spending far less per user on both our pay-per-click and our SEO work. Also, fashion plays like this tend to be highly viral

premises.text: The platform differentiates itself by allowing in-season merchandise to be sold at wholesale prices
premises.evidence_span: no one is able to buy in-season merchandise at the full wholesale cost and resell it for a significant discount because it's just not profitable

premises.text: The platform creates buzz for luxury brands as their merchandise hits the market
premises.evidence_span: helping to create buzz around their in-season merchandise just as it's hitting the department store floors

value.text: Women gain access to coveted handbags and accessories through a unique pricing model
value.evidence_span: we allow women to choose the price they want to pay for the most coveted handbags and accessories that either never or rarely go on sale

notes: ARPU numbers and competitor mapping are excluded as they do not represent premises.
